scope: Read-only summaries of existing 12 accepted r3 metrics/history and frozen implementation; no training or inference.

aggregation.cycle_r2cb_pa: For each physical frame compute case-balanced R2 around the case-balanced global truth mean; arithmetic mean over 81 frames. It is not mean per-case R2. Pa truth is raw/unclipped; predictions exp(ln_pred)-eps clipped at zero.
aggregation.cycle_r2cb_ln: Same frame-wise case-balanced R2, using ln(max(WSS,0.05 Pa)+1e-6) on truth and prediction, then mean over frames. Global ln accuracy does not identify improvements in spatial low-WSS regions.
aggregation.trough: 20 physical frames with smallest shared protocol Q; this is a temporal subset, not a spatial low-WSS mask.
aggregation.ts_corr_ln: At each wall point, Pearson correlation across 81 floored-log frames; exclude point if product-norm denominator <=1e-12. Mean over valid points within each case; nanmean over cases. Valid-point counts are not saved.
aggregation.amp_err_ln_med: At each point, absolute error in ln peak-to-trough range over 81 frames; median over points within each case; arithmetic mean over cases. This is neither pooled point median nor physical-Pa amplitude error.
aggregation.peak_time_err_med_frames: Per-point argmax index difference in floored log WSS, wrapped by min(d,80-d) for 81 samples including cycle endpoints; median per case; arithmetic mean over cases.
aggregation.peak_time_err_p90_frames: Same per-point cyclic index difference; 90th percentile within each case, then arithmetic mean across cases. It is NOT p90 over all points and is NOT p90 across cases.
aggregation.fold_aggregation: Report and this diagnostic take the arithmetic mean over folds; held-out case counts are 46,46,44. A mean of fold summary statistics is not a pooled-point metric.
aggregation.sampling: Frame spacing is 0.01 s (Fluent step increment 2); period 0.8 s. Endpoint samples share phase; cyclic distance uses 80 intervals.
aggregation.training_loss: Each history loss_z is mean of 30 stochastic minibatch MSEs of (predicted ln WSS minus training floored ln truth)/training-fold per-frame sd. First entry is first-epoch average after updates have begun, not untrained initial loss.

limitations: No validation trajectory: training loss alone cannot establish overfitting, sufficient convergence, or the benefit of a longer budget.
One seed and development folds: fold consistency is descriptive and does not substitute for training-seed replication or independent confirmation.
No per-case temporal metrics or r3 point predictions persisted: no claim that most cases or spatial low-WSS regions improve.
Phase windows are descriptive, selected from shared-waveform landmarks, not preregistered hypothesis tests.
Full-minus-diagonal estimates temporal interaction effects under the frozen representation, protocol and 1800-step budget; it does not establish physical memory or new-waveform generalization.
Raw arms retain the common peak prediction anchor; warm-minus-raw isolates access to the additional frozen query_x feature block, not presence versus absence of all transferred information.
